audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits WR 48.70 over 577 games: Taliyah bullies the weak early Ekko, his Chronobreak spike and reset skirmishing carry mid game.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[4]/win[5] off by one against the prose: whys[4], mid and spikes[1] give level 6 (row 4) to Ekko and first item (row 5) back to you, but win[4]=Taliyah and win[5]=Ekko. Full layer's phases[4].side=Ekko corroborates the swap. Rows 0-3 full are blanket Skill and row 6 full says Ekko against agreeing Taliyah content.
audit.why: Kit-grounded: Ekko's only pre-6 engage is Phase Dive (a 325-range dash your E mines stun); Chronobreak at 6 resets combos and heals; first item Taliyah out-shoves his slow clear.
audit.corrected: win[4] Taliyah->Ekko, win[5] Ekko->Taliyah, full sides aligned, whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; the four missing interactions (Chronobreak untargetability dodging your burst, its healing wanting anti-heal, the W anomaly shield absorbing burst, Phase Dive's auto-reset as the burst tell) were absent; Phase-Dive-into-mines never framed as self-harm.
audit.why: Kit: Chronobreak 110/80/50s, untargetable and heals; Parallel Convergence 22/20/18/16/14s with shield on entry; Phase Dive 9s dash with auto-reset; Taliyah E stuns dashers, W knock-through detonates.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries numbers and sequencing; dos/donts now state the dash-detonation and melee tells.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late you out-roam and out-poke him — wall the rewind path in fights and never dive his hologram without vision.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Check it before every step-up. - W Seismic Shove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — 110s at rank 1, 50s at rank 3. It erases your kill and heals him: save final damage for after the rewind. - His W is a 22s cooldown — force it, then commit. - W Seismic Shove is the lifeline; chip never gets it.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Phase Dive ends in melee — that is W's strongest frame: shove him back through your mines and his own dash detonates the stun on him instead.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: His third passive hit and Phase Dive's attack reset live in melee — with W down nothing shoves him back off you before the burst lands.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan across resets; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — the stopwatch covers your cast-time windows.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive; Chronobreak heals, so an anti-heal pickup pays off.

edits.before: Track Ekko’s Chronobreak: Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Ekko’s Chronobreak: he goes untargetable, rewinds and heals — hold your last spell for after it, and force his 22s W shield before all-ins.
